caption: Worked example 1 as a table: the all-4 block's DC 8 rounds to 2 with step 4 and comes back exactly; the all-8 block's DC 16 rounds to 3 with step 6, decodes to DC 18 and pixels of 9, one grey level high. The highlighted quantised DC is the only lossy step.

spec.title: Worked example: all-4 block (left), all-8 block (right)
spec.aria: A table of two 2×2 blocks, all 4s and all 8s, showing pixels, DCT coefficients, quantised DC, decoded coefficients, decoded pixels and the error of 0 and +1.
